gloss_en: The imaginative faculty (koach ha-medameh, הַמְדַמֶּה) — the imagination as a psychic power that opposes and confuses the intellect/spirit of prophecy, identified in Likutey Moharan I:54 with the evil spirit, spirit of folly, and depressed spirit (atzvut ruach), which is subdued through joy and music; not the verb 'resembles/compares' in other contexts
